result.question: How did Uzziah trespass against Yahweh, his God, when he became powerful?

readings.answer: By entering the temple to burn incense on the altar of incense
readings.support: he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense

readings.answer: By trying to offer incense to Yahweh, a duty reserved for priests
readings.support: you have no right to offer incense to the LORD.

assessments.reason: It matches 26:16 verbatim: “he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense,” exactly the key’s wording.

Saying he tried to offer incense, a priest-only duty, is supported by 26:18 (“you have no right to offer incense… Only the priests… are consecrated to burn incense”) and captures the same trespass though it omits the explicit mention of entering the temple and the altar.
